what: When you hover a button with only the top-right corner rounded, the rounded corner moves to the bottom right in .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and the ↗ arrow inside turns 45° to point →. It returns when you move away. With look: start, the rounded side moves to the top left (card stack)

options.look: With start, the rounded corner moves from top right → top left (service card .6s)
options.--fx-r: Corner radius (css), default 1.6rem — cards clamp(2.5rem,5vw,5rem), round prev/next buttons 1.4rem
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Travel distance and curve (css), default .5s · cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)

note: Background and text color are painted by the user — the part moves only the corners and arrow

from.where: shared.css .btn (↗ rotates 45°) · index.css .nav-btn (1.4rem) · .svc (look: start, clamp(2.5rem,5vw,5rem), .6s) — original .btn:hover{border-start-end-radius:0;border-end-end-radius:1.6rem} transition border-radius .5s var(--ease-expo)
